messages:
incident-bot: SEV-2: High error rate on production inference pool (gpu-serving-*) — CUDA illegal memory access observed. Linking incident page: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2026-451. Auto-assigned to oncall: @catalina.

catalina: taking it. visible in dashboards: evictions spiked ~15:04 UTC, pods restarting.

dylan: seeing repeated container restarts on node-gpu-17 and node-gpu-03. log snippet: `E Cuda: CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_ADDRESS at 0x7fffa3b2` then `worker crashed: signal 11`.

eng-runtime: confirmed similar traces in runtime logs across 3 pods. suspect kernel misaligned access inside custom attention kernel. sample backtrace: `gpu_kernel_attn+0x2b4`, `launch_attention.cu:128`.

maria: any customer impact yet? which tenants hit 5xx?

dylan: early numbers: ~2.3k failed requests in last 10m, spikes concentrated on multi-tenant route /v1/generate for customers: [acme-inc, flux-ai, beta-sandbox]. P95 latency for that route increased from 220ms -> 1.6s before failures.

eng-sre: plan: 1) cordon node-gpu-17/03, 2) evict pods to force fallback to CPU/dedicated capacity, 3) trigger autoscaler to spin up warm CPU workers. Suggest CPU fallback variant: `redwood/model-x-cpu-v2`.

oncall-sre: executing cordon on node-gpu-17 now.

opsbot: `kubectl cordon node-gpu-17` returned success.

opsbot: `kubectl drain node-gpu-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` started; evicting 6 pods.

dylan: starting a hot fallback: updating route policy to prefer `model-x-cpu-v2` for the affected app namespace. Posting rollout: `traffic-split: 80% cpu, 20% gpu`

opsbot: rollout triggered: policy-change-id=pol-98712. Traffic rebalancer active.

eng-runtime: note: crash appears correlated with driver version `nvidia-driver 535.86` and our custom fused-kernel. We saw similar in staging but not reproducible. Kernel oops lines in dmesg point to `kmem` boundary check failure. Collecting dmesg + /var/log/nvidia*.

eng-platform: please capture coredump and run: ```
sudo journalctl -k -n 200 > /tmp/dmesg-6578912345.log
sudo cp /var/log/nvidia-installer.log /tmp/
sudo systemd-coredumpctl gdb --no-pager > /tmp/core-gpu-$(date +%s).log
```

dylan: pasted minimal dmesg extract: `[12345.678901] NVRM: GPU 3: GPU has fallen off the bus.` `[12345.678912] Cuda: illegal memory access at 0x7fffa3b2` `backtrace: gpu_kernel_attn+0x2b4`

eng-runtime: also tracked process-level metrics: GPU mem fragmentation high, many small allocations ~32KB. suspect allocator race on concurrent reloads.

maria: prepping customer comms now. Draft: "We are investigating intermittent inference failures for a small subset of requests; mitigation in progress. We will update in 30m or when we have ETA." Anyone want to add details?

catalina: please state mitigations: nodes cordoned, traffic shifted to CPU variant, we will continue to drain affected nodes.

eng-sre: next steps: collect full coredumps, identify driver/kernel version delta across fleet, run targeted repro on a spare node with instrumentation enabled (`I_GDB=1 ATTENTION_KERNEL_DEBUG=1`). If reproducible, rollback driver or patch fused-kernel.

eng-platform: note: collecting `nv-hostengine` logs and enabling `CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1` on one repro pod to see exact failure location. Command to inject env into debug pod: `kubectl set env deploy/debug-pod CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1 --namespace infra-debug`

opsbot: statuspage update queued: partial degradation for inference-hosting; impacted customers: acme-inc, flux-ai, beta-sandbox. Next update in 20m.

oncall-sre: handing off to @dylan for next 30m (I have a meeting). If nothing critical, keep mitigation (drain + fallback).

dylan: ack. I'll keep monitoring and post CPU fallback success metrics. Initial check: error rate dropped ~70% after traffic shift.

incident-bot: On-call handover recorded: from catalina -> dylan at 6578912565. SLA timer paused.

eng-runtime: quick hypothesis: race occurs when KV-cache refill + fused attention kernel allocate/free interleaving under heavy concurrent seq_len variance. Patch candidate: add allocation lock + boundary checks. Will prototype in staging.

maria: sent customer blurb. keeping support loop open.

catalina: leaving notes in incident doc. If we get repro, prioritize hotpatch to fused kernel or driver rollback.

opsbot: drain finished for node-gpu-17. Node marked unschedulable.

eng-sre: creating follow-up ticket: INF-9876 (investigate fused-kernel race and driver compatibility). Assigning to eng-runtime + eng-platform.

dylan: monitoring shows residual errors on node-gpu-03 — cordoning that next. Will update timeline.

eng-platform: reminder: attach `kubectl logs --previous` outputs for crashed pods to ticket.

incident-bot: Incident status: mitigation in progress, partial traffic fallback active, customers notified.

catalina: closing initial triage. next update in 20m or on repro.
